```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % base-ent "system-id">
  <!ENTITY % param-ent "<!ENTITY ext-ent 'Resolved %base-ent;'>">
  %param-ent;
  <?pi-target processing instruction data?>
  <!-- Top-level catalog comment -->
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Section comment -->
  <item>&ext-ent;</item>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA block with markup-like characters: <tag attr="val">&entity;</tag>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (content)*>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY internal "InternalEntity">
  <!ENTITY external SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <!-- DTD-level comment inside DOCTYPE -->
]>
<document xmlns="urn:doc:namespace" xmlns:sub="urn:doc:sub">
  <!-- Root level comment -->
  <?custom-pi data="value"?>
  <sub:content>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block containing XML declarations: <?xml version="1.0"?>
    ]]>
    &internal;
  </sub:content>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY de1 'deep1'>">
  <!ENTITY % p2 "<!ENTITY de2 '&de1; deep2'>">
  %p1;
  %p2;
  <?xml-custom-pi action="init"?>
  <!-- Comprehensive DTD comment block -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:custom="http://example.com/custom">
  <!-- Comment before nodes -->
  <custom:node>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section spanning multiple lines
      with special characters: <, >, &, ", '
    ]]>
    &de2;
  </custom:node>
  <?processing-instruction test="true"?>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product)*>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock "In Stock">
  <!ENTITY status "&stock; - Ready">
  <?inventory-manager version="2.0"?>
  <!-- Inventory schema definition comment -->
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/inventory" xmlns:inv="http://schemas.example.com/inventory/details">
  <!-- Comment inside root element -->
  <inv:product>
    <![CDATA[
      <inv:details>CDATA wrapped XML content & entities</inv:details>
    ]]>
    &status;
  </inv:product>
  <?target-pi data="test-processing"?>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting)*>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % remote-ent "<!ENTITY loaded-ent 'RemoteValue'>">
  %remote-ent;
  <?config-processor mode="strict"?>
  <!-- Configuration DTD comment -->
]>
<config xmlns="http://cfg.example.org" xmlns:cfg="http://cfg.example.org/schema">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <cfg:setting>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block preventing parsing of &loaded-ent; inside CDATA
    ]]>
    &loaded-ent;
  </cfg:setting>
  <?cfg-pi command="execute"?>
</config>
```
